findings.current: Even he couldn’t have known our family would endure for so long.
findings.defect: “Couldn’t have known” expresses impossibility, while 모르셨겠지 is a conjecture that he probably did not know. The accepted baseline preserves that uncertainty.
findings.rationale: The Korean uses a conjectural ending, not a claim that he could not have known.
findings.replacement: Even he probably didn’t know our family would endure for so long.

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall. One minor modal shift makes Jin Wikyung’s thought more certain than the Korean establishes.
